description: Use this when a buyer asks what a work will cost delivered to them and when it would arrive. Given one listing_id and a US destination (a five-digit ZIP code, and the state if known), it answers with the price, the seller’s delivery charge, an ESTIMATE of sales tax from Fold’s tax engine for that ZIP code, the total, the date the seller says it ships by and the arrival window their transit estimate gives, the returns that apply, the policy links and how to check out. Read-only: nothing is opened or reserved. Checkout calculates the exact tax from the full address before the buyer pays. Fold delivers only to the 50 US states and DC.

country.description: US: Fold delivers only within the US.

region.description: The state, e.g. CO or Colorado.
